question: Do the monitors still work when every strategy has different noise characteristics, instead of one fixed parameter point?

per_strategy_parameters.drawn: once per strategy, held for the whole window, independent of the state and of every noise stream
per_strategy_parameters.status: a simulation choice fixed before the run; not estimated from any market and not specified by the supervisor

parameter_roles.A: how far the volatility level swings
parameter_roles.rho: how long a volatility level persists
parameter_roles.K: how many jumps land on a given day

normalisation: divide by the THEORETICAL constant sqrt(1 + kappa_i^2 lambda/D) for that path's own kappa; never by a path's sample mean or sample variance
batch_independence: parameters and noise are drawn independently per batch; the two test batches are shared across methods so the comparisons are paired
thresholds: one per method, calibrated on the whole mixed calibration population, then frozen; never chosen using true A, kappa, post-hoc groups or test results
detector_inputs: returns only; no latent volatility, no jump labels, no true parameters
out_of_sample_scope: the test batches are genuinely out of sample, but they come from the SAME generating family as calibration; this is not evidence about real strategy returns
